note: Body/garment region IDs (memo 4.3 rule 6). Written into UV2.x of every body and head vertex by bl_assemble.py; a garment declares hides: [names] and the skin/cloth shaders collapse those regions from one uniform bitmask. IDs are bit positions: never renumber, only append. 19-22 (2026-10-16) split the bands a neckline or sleeve stops inside off upper_chest, back and the upper arms, so those can be hidden under a shirt; 23-24 the ankle a boot shaft encloses.
